candidate.name: MCL Continuous Multihorizon Auction Relay
candidate.structural_change: replace fixed Asia/Europe/U.S. opening ownership with one continuously recomputed completed-five-minute auction state

causal_clock.source: one-minute matched CL/MCL tape aggregated into completed five-minute bars
causal_clock.decision: only after a completed five-minute bar
causal_clock.history: strictly prior 24 completed five-minute bars; reset on contract roll or non-maintenance discontinuity
causal_clock.entry_hours_et: 18:00 through 16:25; no entry during maintenance or the final pre-halt interval

shared_state.direction_votes: sign of CL close changes over 15, 30, 60, and 120 minutes
shared_state.coherence: at least three of four votes agree
shared_state.path_efficiency: absolute 60-minute CL displacement divided by the sum of absolute completed-five-minute changes
shared_state.atr_ratio: 30-minute completed-five-minute true range mean divided by the 120-minute mean
shared_state.matched_parity: the latest completed five-minute MCL move must agree with the proposed direction
shared_state.mutual_exclusion: trend and balance efficiency bands cannot overlap; one position maximum

two_speeds.trend_acceptance: coherence agrees, 60-minute efficiency is at least the declared trend threshold, ATR ratio is at least 0.90, and the completed CL close exceeds the prior 30-minute extreme by 0.05 slow ATR; target one slow ATR, initial stop 0.75 slow ATR, maximum hold 60 minutes
two_speeds.balance_reversal: 60-minute efficiency is at most the declared balance threshold, ATR ratio is at most 1.05, and the completed CL bar probes beyond the prior 60-minute extreme by 0.10 slow ATR but closes back inside; reverse toward the causal 60-minute CL volume-weighted typical price, stop 0.25 slow ATR beyond the probe, maximum hold 45 minutes
two_speeds.shared_exit: target or stop first under conservative bar ordering; otherwise exit next MCL open when at least three of four completed horizons oppose the position
two_speeds.rearm: after exit, wait three completed five-minute bars and require the prior entry-direction coherence to dissolve; this is state reset, not a quota

bounded_cells.ranking: discovery eligibility first, then positive quarter count, worst quarter primary and stress net, stress net/intrabar-DD, stress profit factor, and primary net; validation cannot select a cell

fixed_owners.roll: dual prior-session CL/MCL volume cross, forced three complete sessions before MCL expiry

proof_windows.missing_challenge_prefix: 2023-07 through 2024-08 remains a hard coronation blocker

prohibitions: no fixed session-block permission or calendar routing
no target, stop, timeout, horizon, or coherence sweep
no crown without the missing first challenge year
